subject: Geopolitics
title: Resource Wars of the Future
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Resource Wars of the Future.

hook.text: The 20th century was shaped by oil. The 21st will be shaped by lithium, water, chips, and data.

buildup.text: Every energy transition creates winners and losers. Coal killed sail. Oil killed coal. Renewables will kill oil.

discovery.text: The resources change but the pattern doesn't: nations hoard, compete, and fight over what powers their world.

twist.text: Data may become the most fought-over resource. It fuels AI, surveillance, and economic advantage. It never runs out.

climax.text: Future resource wars will be hybrid: economic sanctions, cyber raids, supply chain blocks, and mineral embargoes.

punchline.text: The resources change. The wars don't.

quiz.question: Why might data become the most contested resource of the future?
options: Data is the rarest resource on Earth
It fuels AI, surveillance, and economic advantage and never runs out
Only a few countries can produce data
